legacy_sports_db.description: Reads legacy shared sports.db instead of sport-specific sql-mlb.db/duck-mlb.duckdb.

warehouse_cli.description: Shells into the legacy MLB warehouse CLI instead of a typed DB adapter.

published_data_input.description: Uses public/site mirrors as model inputs.

private_prediction_json_input.description: Uses generated prediction JSON artifacts as model inputs.

private_prediction_json_output.description: Writes generated prediction JSON artifacts as compatibility outputs.

raw_archive_input.description: Uses raw/archive files directly instead of typed source tables.

generated_module_input.description: Uses generated modules/files that should become DB-derived exports.

legacy_sqlite_shell.description: Uses sqlite shell calls, often pointing at legacy DB paths.

db_ready_reference.description: Already references sport-specific SQLite/DuckDB inputs or the DB-first shared day-game loader.
